outcome: admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: 60 pregnant women between 18 and 35 years old with low-risk pregnancies presenting for obstetrical ultrasound at 35 weeks of gestation or later with planned delivery at the hospital.
finding: In low-risk patients with estimated fetal weight (EFW) >10th centile and abnormal CPR, there was a significant association with adverse obstetric outcomes.
